## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

detailed_description:
The target video is a high-end Chinese 3D xianxia fantasy animation, cinematic and physically coherent, with detailed cloth and hair simulation, crisp readable action, luminous jade-green vegetation, white stone paving, carved corridors, an elegant pavilion, ornamental rocks, a koi pond, bamboo and flowering trees shedding drifting petals; bright neutral white daylight with soft realistic shadows, no sunset and no golden-hour tint.
[Shot 1] A slightly elevated three-quarter wide shot frames <Subject 1> on the LEFT and <Subject 2> on the RIGHT, and the camera descends while pushing forward. <Subject 1> sweeps one hand across her body and a thin layer of frost races over the white stone beneath her feet; several sharp ice blades form around her wrist and shoot toward him in a curved, coordinated volley. He immediately raises his palm, thick green vines burst from the paving, weave together into a curved wooden shield and intercept the blades; ice shatters into sparkling fragments, and he steps out from behind the shield and sends a low vine sweep toward her legs.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the shot cuts to a low, fast tracking shot moving with the fighters. <Subject 1> glides laterally across the fresh ice, narrowly avoids the sweeping vine and dashes directly into close range; he retracts the vine and catches her incoming forearm with his guarded arm, and their arms collide with a sharp impact. She rotates her wrist, coats her forearm in hard translucent ice, breaks free and delivers a quick palm strike toward his shoulder; he blocks with a woody forearm guard, slides backward half a step, feints a short elbow and counters with a compact palm strike, and she pivots away from it while her sleeves and long hair react to the impacts.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a medium two-shot with the camera orbiting partially around them at chest height. <Subject 1> forms a narrow ice blade along her palm and launches a rapid diagonal slash followed by a reverse cut; <Subject 2> manifests a curved branch blade and meets both strikes in quick succession, and the blades collide at close range, throwing bright ice chips and green leaves into the air. Living tendrils coil around her weapon arm; she instantly freezes them solid, they crack and shatter, and she steps inside his guard and strikes his forearm with her icy palm, and he absorbs the impact with a wooden brace and redirects her momentum sideways.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.500, a brief high-angle crane shot follows them, then cuts to a low three-quarter full-body shot. <Subject 1> spins out of the redirection and sweeps one arm outward, creating a crescent-shaped wave of ice mist across the paving; <Subject 2> rapidly grows several wooden roots from the ground to anchor his footing, vaults over the advancing frost, and she follows his movement with a fan of small ice blades. He twists in midair and deflects the blades with two fast branch whips that break apart into leaves and splinters, lands close to her instead of retreating, and they immediately exchange two rapid blocks and a shoulder-to-forearm clash.
[Shot 5] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to a dynamic medium shot with a short sideways track and a partial push-in. <Subject 2> hooks her attacking arm with a flexible vine, pulls it off line and steps forward with a controlled palm strike; <Subject 1> turns her torso, catches the strike against her ice-covered forearm and redirects it, and their arms remain in direct contact for a brief forceful struggle. She suddenly releases a circular burst of frost between them, forcing him to disengage and slide backward; as he regains his balance he raises a curved wooden barrier, and she fires a concentrated icy palm strike into it, spreading intricate frost cracks across its surface without completely destroying it.
[Shot 6] At 00:12.500, the camera sweeps into a wide three-quarter shot. <Subject 1> accelerates into one final combination: a low sliding step, a rising palm strike and a pair of crossing ice ribbons; <Subject 2> pivots around the first strike, blocks the rising palm with his forearm and raises interwoven branches to intercept the ribbons. Ice and wood collide in a burst of crystalline fragments, leaves and fine mist, and the magical shockwave pushes both fighters apart, their robes and hair flowing in the gust; neither is seriously injured, both land on their feet and immediately regain balanced guarded stances.
[Shot 7] At 00:14.200, the shot cuts to a stable wide master shot with a very slow camera push-in. <Subject 1> remains on the LEFT and <Subject 2> on the RIGHT, approximately two to three meters apart, facing each other; a few ice crystals drift between them while loose green leaves settle around their feet. Their hands remain partially raised, with faint ice energy around her fingers and a fading emerald glow around his palm, and they breathe steadily and maintain eye contact without attacking; this precise composition is held unchanged through the final frame, creating a natural pause for seamless continuation into the next clip.

overall_soundscape:
Only diegetic fight and magic sounds are present, with no ambience bed: ice blades chiming and shattering, frost crackling, wet woody cracks and creaking vines, wooden shields snapping, crisp forearm-on-forearm and shin-on-wood impacts, wide sleeves and skirts snapping through fast turns, quick footwork scuffs and pivots on stone, and short controlled breaths.
